dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' structures exhibit irregular, sinuous dark perimeters with high rugosity, transitioning sharply from high-contrast dark boundaries to light-toned internal centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, low-intensity pixel clusters appearing as solid dark spots distributed primarily in the interstitial spaces between larger annular patterns and along the superior dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent lateral annuli form a non-uniform quadrilateral with the longest axis oriented longitudinally along the mid-body.

other_distinctive_markers: Set of three parallel, vertical curvilinear dark bands located on the anterior dorsal region near the neck transition.
